author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕೂಡುವುದು ಕಳೆಯುವುದು ಗುಣಿಸುವುದು ಭಾಗಿಪುದು
ಜೋಡಿಸುವ ಬೇರ್ಪಡಿಪ ಶಕುತಿಯೊಂದಿಹುದು
ಆಡಿಸುವ ಜಗವನ್ನೆ ತನಗಿಷ್ಟ ಬಂದಂತೆ
ಮೋಡಿಮಾಡುವನವನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: there is one power that joins and parts;
it makes the whole world dance as it pleases:
he is the great enchanter, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Behind all the adding and taking away, the joining and separating in our lives, there is a single power. It moves the whole world as it wills; that is the divine enchanter at work.
